runbook: R-18 / R-19 (independent oracle; evidence tree = `git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md` only)
question: Should the coupled combat ledger carry a sixth support event owned by the main (attacker-side) participant in a Black Cleaver + Bloodsong roster fight?

step_1_what_a_support_event_is.claim: In this engine a `support_event` is a heal/shield ledger entry (self-targeted or ally-targeted), not a damage/amp/shred entry.
evidence: data/worklists/e8d-task.md: 'ALLY-SUPPORT heals/shields (champion emits a support event targeting allies; the ledger already tracks support_shield_received / support heals from items — reuse the same event shape)'
data/champion-audit/batch-p1-1.json (Akshan): 'API evidence: one \'Dirty Fighting (3-Stack Shield)\' support event at 280.0, support_shield_received 280.0; passive_procs=0 emits none.'
data/champion-audit/batch-p1-3.json (Lux): 'W Prismatic Barrier shields Lux ... emitted as a self-targeted support shield'
step_1_what_a_support_event_is.consequence: An event's `owner` names the participant whose heal/shield it is. A main-owned support event therefore requires the main participant to actually emit a heal or a shield in this fight.

black_cleaver.Carve: Dealing physical damage to an enemy champion applies a stack of Carve for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts 6% armor reduction, up to 30% at 5 stacks.
black_cleaver.Fervor: Dealing physical damage grants you 20 bonus movement speed for 2 seconds.

bloodsong.Spellblade: After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals 100% base AD bonus physical damage on-hit. If the target is a champion, inflict them with Expose Weakness for 4 seconds, causing them to take 8%/5% (melee/ranged) increased damage from all sources (1.5 second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).
bloodsong.Ward: Consumes a charge to place a Stealth Ward at the target location.
bloodsong.stats: 200 health, 75% base health regen, 75% base mana regen, 9 gold/10s
bloodsong.note: Bloodsong is the only one of the five Bounty of Worlds upgrades with no heal/shield/bonus-health payload — Celestial Opposition, Dream Maker and Solstice Sleigh (data/items.json 3876 'Going Sledding': bonus health to you and the most wounded ally) do have one, Zaz'Zak's and Bloodsong do not. So the item side of this scenario cannot author a support event for anyone, main or ally.

step_2_items_in_this_scenario_grant_no_h.conclusion: Neither named item can author a heal/shield event for the main participant. Any main-owned support event must come from the main champion's own kit.

step_3_the_form_champion_that_pairs_with.champion: Gnar (Black Cleaver is his signature item; the branch under test is form/Mega-shaped, and Gnar is the only Black-Cleaver-core form champion in the roster)

kit_scan.P Rage Gene: Rage generation + form switch + per-form stat bonuses. No heal, no shield.
kit_scan.Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss: physical damage + slow. No heal, no shield.
kit_scan.W Hyper / Wallop: 3rd-stack bonus magic damage + movement speed / stun. No heal, no shield.
kit_scan.E Hop / Crunch: leap, damage, slow, attack speed. No heal, no shield.
kit_scan.R GNAR!: knock-away, damage, slow/stun. No heal, no shield.

mega_transform_health_is_not_a_heal.quote_1: data/champions.json Gnar P notes: 'Mega Gnar's gained health is not affected by healing modifiers such as Grievous Wounds and those from items and runes.'
mega_transform_health_is_not_a_heal.quote_2: data/champions.json Gnar P notes: 'When returning to Mini Gnar, Gnar will only retain his current health percentage, not current health total.'
mega_transform_health_is_not_a_heal.quote_3: data/champions.json Gnar P effects: 'Gnar gains different stat bonuses based on whether he is in Mini or Mega form.'
mega_transform_health_is_not_a_heal.reading: The Mega-form health is a max-health stat delta whose current-health share rides along proportionally (the repo's own taxonomy calls this heal-shield.max-health-increase-restores-current, e.g. data/item-atoms/3877.json). It is explicitly outside healing-modifier space (immune to Grievous Wounds / heal-and-shield power) and reverts by percentage, which is the defining behaviour of a max-health buff and NOT of a heal. Emitting it as a support (heal/shield) event would put it inside the heal ledger, where healing_reduction.py's 0.60 Grievous factor and heal-and-shield power would be free to touch it (docs/math-foundations.md, 'Grievous Wounds ... multiplicative factor 0.60 ... strongest-wins composition') — a modelling error the wiki text forbids. CLAUDE.md corroborates the intended modelling: 'Mega's deltas are base stats, not bonus.'

independent_computation.step_4_result: There is no cached source under data/ that authorizes a heal or shield owned by the main participant in a Black Cleaver + Bloodsong roster fight: neither item grants one, and the form champion's kit grants none in either form, while the Mega transform's health gain is a stat delta the wiki explicitly excludes from healing. The correct support_events list for this scenario therefore contains only the ally-side entries; index [5] (a main-owned entry) should not exist, so its `owner` leaf is correctly absent.

data/champion-audit/batch-p1-1.json (Akshan) and batch-p1-3.json (Lux) — support events are heal/shield payloads, self-targeted ones included
docs/math-foundations.md §5 — Grievous Wounds / shield rows, confirming the heal-shield ledger is the modifier-bearing path that a stat delta must stay out of
residual_uncertainty: The scenario's exact roster (champion names, levels, fight window) is defined in scripts//tests/, which this runbook forbids reading, so the main champion's identity is inferred from the item pairing (Black Cleaver core) rather than read. The step-2 argument is champion-independent (neither named item can author a support event for the main); step 3 is the champion-specific leg.

If the main participant in this scenario were instead a champion with a genuine self-heal or self-shield ability, a main-owned support event could be legitimate and the verdict would flip to old_value_correct. Nothing under data/ names such a champion for this scenario.
